title: soupstacking
description: A mod that allows stacking any food item with the word 'Soup' in its name up to 16 pieces.
body:
This mod automatically changes the maximum stack size for all items that contain the word "soup" in any language:



```
English: soup
Russian: суп
Deutsch: suppe
Français: soupe
Español: sopa
Italiano: zuppa
and more
```


**Features:**

✅ Works with all vanilla Minecraft soups

✅ Compatible with mod-added soups

✅ Auto-detects soups by name

✅ Multi-language support

✅ Uses Mixin for reliability
